faq.title: FAQ
faq.heading: Questions dermatology practices ask before signing.

items.q: Is HIPAA-compliant email marketing actually possible?
items.a: Yes — with strict rules. We never include PHI in email content, subject lines, or tracking parameters. Segmentation uses non-PHI tags (interest, campaign, consent status), consent is explicit at the point of visit or web form, and every send goes through a compliance review checklist. When protected data must move (e.g. appointment links tied to a chart), we route users to your secure patient portal instead of exposing anything in-mail.

items.q: Which email platforms and PMS/EHR systems do you support?
items.a: We build on Klaviyo, HubSpot, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, or Customer.io depending on your practice size and integrations. On the clinical side we integrate with ModMed / EMA, Nextech, DrChrono, athenahealth, and others via API, HL7, or Zapier — automated triggers fire from real appointment data, not manual spreadsheets.

Every campaign is scored on booked appointments and attributed revenue — not just opens and clicks. We instrument UTM tags on every link, wire click-throughs to your booking or portal system, and report monthly on open rate, CTR, appointment bookings, and estimated revenue per send.

items.q: What about deliverability and inbox placement?
items.a: Setup includes SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication, a sender warm-up plan if you're moving from a legacy platform, quarterly list-hygiene sweeps, and sender-reputation monitoring via Google Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS. Practices typically move from 82–88% inbox placement into the 96–98% range within 60–90 days.

items.q: How often will you email our patients?
items.a: Cadence is calibrated to your list, not a template. Most dermatology practices send 2 education emails per month plus automated triggers (welcome, recall, birthday). We never over-mail — unsubscribe and complaint rates are watched weekly, and cadence is dialed back the moment they drift above target.

items.q: Do you write the copy or does our team?
items.a: We write everything — subject lines, body copy, plain-text fallback — in your provider's voice, reviewed by our HIPAA copy checklist. Your team approves each campaign in a shared calendar; nothing sends without a sign-off.

Flat monthly retainer scoped to list size and campaign volume. Included: strategy, calendar, template design, copywriting, deliverability, automation setup, PMS integration, and monthly reporting. No per-send fees, no long contracts after the first 90 days.
